trail_walk.title: Forest Recovery Trail Walk
trail_walk.terrain_suggestion: Packed dirt trail or gentle woodland path

blocks.instruction: Easy conversational walking pace, gentle neck and shoulder rolls
Brisk uphill cadence, engaging core and arm drive on inclines
Slow stroll and deep nasal breathing with calf stretches

fartlek_run.title: Open Trail Landmark Fartlek
fartlek_run.terrain_suggestion: Undulating park loop or packed dirt trail

blocks.instruction: Gentle jog with high knees and butt kicks
Surge hard between trail markers (benches/trees), jog easy to recover
Slow jog into walk, followed by hamstring and hip flexor stretches

rucking.title: Weighted Trail Ruck
rucking.terrain_suggestion: Variable gravel and packed dirt with rolling grades

blocks.instruction: Steady baseline stride, adjusting rucksack fit and posture
Consistent power pace, maintaining upright chest and upright head
Unload weight or walk smoothly, perform shoulder and lower back decompression

interval_sprints.title: Hill & Flat Trail Repeats
interval_sprints.terrain_suggestion: Gradual trail incline or flat grass field

blocks.instruction: Progressive light jog and dynamic leg swings
6 x 30-second near-max surges with 90 seconds recovery walk
Gentle cool-down walk and static stretching
